{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient rows, keeping the one with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures we only use the most recent test for each patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the column names
print('Columns:', trial_df.columns.tolist())

# Check the data dictionary again for correct column name
print('\nData dictionary snippet:')
print(open('data/data_dictionary.md', 'r').read().split('`baseline_biomarker`')[0])"}
